caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a bonnet, rendered in colored pencils or similar media. The bonnet's exterior is primarily a deep green color, with visible stitched seams and texture suggesting fabric folds and a quilted or padded appearance. The bonnet's interior is a bright red, with a lighter red lattice or crisscross pattern on part of the lining. A wide red ribbon extends down from the bonnet, hanging vertically. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a light beige or off-white color with no additional objects or scenery. The composition centers the bonnet on the page, making it the sole focus of the drawing.
title: Opera Hood
